title: Fragrance is subtle; guess these are not large enough because they do nothing for me
text:
Fragrance is subtle; guess these are not large enough because they do nothing for me. There are 32 rounds in this package and all but one had a hole in them for installation on a hanger. I think the one without the holes was a mistake. The cedar is so subtle that I have to put it directly under my nose to smell it. I have to put one on every hanger in order to get the full cedar effect. I expected a stronger fragrance. I had a cedar closet years ago and the fragrance was overwhelming but that was probably because the entire closet was made out of cedar. I guess I expected the same.

These can be put in boots, clothes drawers, etc. However, I tried them in all of my drawers (about five to a drawer) and there is no smell or aromatics at all. I am very disappointed in these and am sorry I ordered three boxes.
